canonical.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Cuchara

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Cuchara
siblings.summary: Bosland-anchored cycling, the Achel abbey, plus an honest map of what's actually inside the 30 km circle around Jan Tournier's two-Michelin-star restaurant — and what isn't.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Cuchara
siblings.summary: Hotel Corbie at ~150 m and Mi Casa Naranja at ~4 min walk are the only true walk-back-from-dinner options; Cuchara's other two recommendations are taxi territory.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Cuchara
siblings.summary: A 30 km circle around Cuchara (Lommel) sweeps in Eindhoven's Brainport hub — nearly every IT-relevant event in the radius runs there. Hasselt/Genk fall just outside.

sources.title: Cuchara — restaurant info
sources.claim: Cuchara at Lepelstraat 3, partners with Taxi Flament; recommends Corbiehotel, Wilgenhuys and Ars Vivendi.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Cuchara
sources.claim: Two Michelin stars in 2026 Belgium guide; Tournier opened in 2009, first star 2014, second 2019.

sources.title: B&B Ars Vivendi — official site
sources.claim: 1904 engineer's villa at Werkplaatsen 47, run by Ann and Guido since 2014; three renovated en-suite rooms.

sources.title: Ars Vivendi — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: Ranked #1 specialty lodging in Lommel; 5.0/5 Travelers' Choice.

sources.title: B&B 't Wilgenhuys — official site
sources.claim: Set on the edge of the Lommelse Sahara at Jacob Smitsdreef 2; vintage/Scandi/urban/classical interior mix.

sources.title: 't Wilgenhuys — Booking.com
sources.claim: 9.6 rating; 4 rooms; 2 km from Lommel centre, cycling junction 25 m away.

sources.title: Eikenhoef — official site
sources.claim: Opened summer 2023; 'luxury boutique hotel' in coniferous forest; between cycling junctions 264 and 265.

sources.title: Eikenhoef — Booking reviews
sources.claim: 9.4/10 across 275 verified reviews; one reviewer flagged 'Luxury Boutique' label as overstated.

sources.title: Eikenhoef — Belgium Hotel 24 listing
sources.claim: 4–7 rooms; doubles, family rooms, quadruples with private bathrooms, AC and balconies.

sources.title: Corbie Hotel — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: 8.0/10 across 549 reviews; central, walkable, but small/dated rooms, occasional noise.

sources.title: Hoeven Het Gehucht — official site
sources.claim: 1957 hobby/children's farm at Kortestraat 1, Pelt (Lindelhoeven); run by Rudy and Tania since 2006.

sources.title: Natuur-like Glamping Bosland — official site
sources.claim: Bell tents on wood platforms next to a pond inside Bosland national park.

sources.title: Natuur-like — Booking.com
sources.claim: 8.6/10; tents sleep up to three; compost toilet, no running water, gas-fire cooking.

sources.title: B&B Huis Spaas — Booking.com
sources.claim: Recently renovated historic building in Sint-Huibrechts-Lille; 9.3 for couples.

sources.title: Lommel-Werkplaatsen — Wikipedia (NL)
sources.claim: 1904–1914 garden-city of ~75 listed workers' and managers' dwellings around the former zinc factory.

sources.title: Visit Lommel — Boutique Hotel Eikenhoef
sources.claim: Visit Lommel lists Eikenhoef in its boutique-hotel category.
